claim_scope: Post hoc development-only component attribution over already frozen fixed-geometry energy records. It determines whether the CHA-GB/cavity-dispersion gain can be assigned to an isolated polar or nonpolar swap. It is not model fitting, independent confirmation, a force result, or a runtime-provider admission.

decision.next_research_target: A conservative implementation must preserve a jointly justified CHA-like polar and matching nonpolar/radius parameterization. Porting only PBSA cavity/dispersion to OBC-II or only CHA-GB polar to ACE is rejected.

factorial_shapley_attribution.interpretation: Shapley values allocate the observed endpoint MAE reduction across the two swaps. They do not prove microscopic causality because absolute error is nonlinear and the component parameterizations are coupled.
